validations: AC-01: validate protected requirement — A Behavioral Verification Plan can be created only for an exact APPROVED Work Specification and persists its exact ID, revision and current server-computed digest. DRAFT/SUPERSEDED/missing specs fail before generation/persistence.

AC-02: validate protected requirement — A persisted plan covers every bound Work Specification acceptance ID exactly once with mode BROWSER or HUMAN_ONLY. Missing, duplicate, reordered-to-wrong-text, invented, or conflicting acceptance identities fail validation.

AC-03: validate protected requirement — The behavioral-plan coordinator input is provably limited to the exact Work Specification contract, acceptance map and fixed browser vocabulary. Repository files, candidate source, Preview/browser content and provider evidence are absent.

AC-04: validate protected requirement — Every BROWSER entry compiles through existing `BrowserAction`, `SemanticTarget`, registered viewport and `BrowserWorkflow` constructors. Invalid action fields, arbitrary URLs/selectors/scripts/network material or unregistered viewports fail closed.
AC-05: validate protected requirement — A HUMAN_ONLY criterion contains no executable workflow and cannot be represented as verified behavioral evidence.

AC-06: validate protected requirement — Plan drafts revision monotonically, supersede older DRAFTs, preserve older APPROVED plans until explicit replacement approval, and same-plan reapproval is idempotent.

AC-07: validate protected requirement — Canonical serialized plan content produces one deterministic SHA-256 digest. Read-back recomputation matches persisted digest; structurally equivalent plan content cannot gain alternate identity through key order or incidental formatting.

AC-08: validate protected requirement — Only the authenticated owner of the plan's Work Specification conversation can read, draft or approve a plan. Caller-supplied plan content/status/acceptance IDs are impossible through the public API.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — Desktop and compact/mobile Build Plan surfaces can create, review and approve the plan. Copy clearly distinguishes `verification plan approved` from `application verified`, and HUMAN_ONLY items remain visible.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — Work Specification digest/approval semantics, conversation amendment behavior, Engineering Run state/revision, TEST/VERIFY evidence, source lineage, provider delivery and human REVIEW behavior are unchanged.

AC-11: validate protected requirement — The migration creates only the new table/indexes/constraints, preserves all existing data, and is covered by contract tests. Production schema preflight or release validation proves the table exists before plan routes are treated as ready if a feature flag/readiness guard is required by existing migration conventions.

AC-12: validate protected requirement — Authentic DSPy SpecCritic/SpecCompiler evidence is committed. Focused plan/domain/repository/route/client tests, full API regression, client state/typecheck/export, Python compilation, Workstream Spec Validation, P2 CI, Bounded Autonomy and applicable client visual/smoke checks pass on exact reviewed heads.

critique: P2-V0.23.47 introduces a separately versioned **Behavioral Verification Plan**. The plan is generated only from an exact approved Work Specification, binds exact Work Specification ID/revision and current acceptance IDs exactly once with mode BROWSER or HUMAN_ONLY. This introduces a new layer of complexity and requires careful consideration to ensure that the plan is valid and reliable.
